findings.claim: OECD Steel Outlook 2026 projects global steel excess capacity reaching 745 million tonnes by 2028, utilization falling to 74% or lower from 76% in 2025; most expansion outside OECD, with growing circumvention of trade measures.

worldsteel Oct 2026 cut forecast: global demand flat in 2026 and +1.7% in 2027 (was 2.2%); China demand to fall 2% in 2026 and 1% in 2027. April worldsteel forecast had US demand +1.7% in 2026 and +2.0% in 2027.
findings.source: Engineering News, Global steel demand to remain flat this year on China slowdown

findings.claim: Fastmarkets: Nucor execs say robust demand driving shipments and higher earnings likely to extend into 2027; Q2 call cited demand strength in energy, data centers, automotive, consumer durables, est. US steel demand +2% in 2026.
Nucor Q3 2026 (reported Oct 26): net earnings about $1.32B, $5.80/share; Q4 guided in line with or modestly higher than Q3; West Virginia sheet mill first heat in September.
findings.source: SteelOrbis, Nucor's net income up 14.1 percent in Q3 2026

findings.claim: US new capacity pipeline: ArcelorMittal Calvert EAF expected at full capacity 2H 2026 with second EAF under consideration; U.S. Steel Gary Tin Mill restart early 2027; Big River DRI plant completion 2027; Hyundai Louisiana ~2.7-2.8Mtpa DRI-EAF sheet timeline unclear.
